_comment: Owner-maintained list of editorial blog posts to mine for late-night place LEADS (docs/03 Inlet 4). Leads always land in the pending submissions queue — never directly in `places`. Add URLs of human-curated listicles you trust. NEVER add Zomato, Swiggy, Google Maps, TripAdvisor or any platform whose terms prohibit scraping; the run refuses those hosts outright.
_rules: Editorial blog posts only — never a listings platform.
robots.txt is checked and obeyed for every URL before it is fetched.
At least 5 seconds between requests, identified as BombayNights-leads/1.0.
Only the place name, locality and claimed timing are kept. No prose, no images, no rankings.
Claimed timings are hints for you to verify, never published as fact.
